name: Knyazev
desc: A merchant who sells furnishings and local snowman decorations in Rankova Zorya. Failing to adapt to the business world after only studying business theory and subsequently relying on his father's help to salvage his previous business after being swindled, he has now set up a new shop to gain more practical experience.

customize.text:
<color=#ffffff>Knyazev:</color> Welcome... What can I get for you? Everything here is pretty cheap, anyway...
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: Let's see...</color>
<color=#ffffff>Knyazev:</color> All right. Take your time...
(Opens Shop)
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: Why do you sound so careless...?</color>
<color=#ffffff>Knyazev:</color> Just talking about it makes me... *sigh*... Ah, no, no. Father said I'm not supposed to sigh in front of customers...
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: Did your family have some harsh words for you?</color>
<color=#ffffff>Knyazev:</color> Haha... If only it had stopped at that. My father even took back the money he'd given me to start the business...
<color=#ffffff>Knyazev:</color> ...Still, I can't say he was wrong. I let all that book learning go to my head and assumed knowing the theory was enough to run a business. Then I jumped in unprepared and lost every last Mora to a swindler...
<color=#ffffff>Knyazev:</color> In the end, Father had to step in and clean up the mess, settling things with my business partners and salvaging what he called "the last of my starting capital."
<color=#ffffff>Knyazev:</color> He told me that if I ever wanted another chance at becoming a merchant, I'd have to start from the very bottom and gain some real experience first...
<color=#ffffff>Knyazev:</color> So, following his arrangements, I set up a stall here... But I'd only just finished setting everything up when some new incident broke our near the station. People came running over and told me to evacuate immediately.
<color=#ffffff>Knyazev:</color> None of my stock was damaged, and I've managed to reopen now, but... m—maybe I'm really not cut out for this. It feels like even the heavens are determined not to give me a break...
<color=#ffffff>Knyazev:</color> *sigh*... No, I shouldn't... Ah, who cares? Father's not here to complain about my sighing anyway... *sigh*
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: Goodbye.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Knyazev:</color> Bye. I look forward to your next visit...
Complete Mayskaya's 3 Bing-Bang Finchball challenges (across 3 real days) to unlock in the shop.
